text: Sanborn spoke of a masking step. Tried: the message reversed, a null letter at a regular interval, or nulls at the start, 648 masks in all, each followed by the table with a repeating key.
For each mask, the shortest key length the known letters still allow. None goes below 26, the same floor as with no mask at all.
The best key fragment the known letters force under any mask scores -5.38 as English, worse than the best on a shuffled copper. Masks of this kind add nothing.
